messages.content: The flights are settled. I need the hotel for Tuesday through Friday near the Bothell supplier. The Hilton Garden Inn Seattle/Bothell and the Country Inn & Suites Seattle-Bothell are both within the authorized amount. Compare them for the first morning, not just by map distance.

What time do you need to be at the supplier on Wednesday, and roughly where in Bothell is the site? I also need your expected Tuesday arrival time to check whether either property creates a late-arrival problem.

The site is near North Creek Parkway and 220th Street SE. I need to be in the lobby by 7:45 a.m. Tuesday's flight reaches SEA at 8:22 a.m., but I have meetings elsewhere during the day and will probably reach the hotel between 8:30 and 9:30 p.m.

For that site, the Hilton Garden Inn is the stronger location. It is roughly 3 to 4 miles away, commonly about 8 to 12 minutes early in the morning, though I would allow 20 minutes for traffic and parking. The Country Inn is closer to the I-405 interchange but farther south; a realistic weekday estimate is about 15 to 25 minutes, with more exposure to northbound congestion. For a 7:45 arrival, I would plan to leave the Hilton around 7:20 and the Country Inn around 7:05.
Breakfast matters because I do not want to discover that it starts at 7:00. What are the actual weekday hours at each?

The published information is not equally clear. The Country Inn generally advertises complimentary breakfast, with weekday service commonly beginning at 6:00 a.m. The Hilton Garden Inn lists cooked-to-order breakfast for purchase, but the available property information does not give me a dependable current opening time. That schedule needs direct confirmation because a 6:30 versus 7:00 opening materially changes your first morning.
Check the other practical points too: late arrival and an itemized receipt suitable for an expense report.

Both properties operate a 24-hour front desk, so an 8:30 to 9:30 p.m. arrival should be routine. You should still add the arrival time to the reservation; if the day runs later, call before midnight so the room is not treated as a no-show. Both can issue an itemized folio at checkout when booked directly. The folio should separate nightly room rate, taxes, parking, breakfast, and incidentals. A prepaid third-party rate could leave the room charge on a third-party receipt, so direct booking is cleaner for reimbursement.
Does either one charge for parking? Include that because it may put the rate over the cap.

The Country Inn advertises complimentary self-parking. The Hilton Garden Inn has also commonly listed complimentary on-site self-parking, but parking terms can change and should be verified on the exact rate screen. If both selected rates show free parking, the Hilton's paid breakfast is the main likely add-on; the Country Inn includes breakfast in the room rate.
So the Country Inn is administratively simpler, but it gives up time in the morning. Is that a fair reading?

Yes. The Country Inn offers the cleaner bundled cost: included breakfast, free parking, and a standard hotel folio. Its drawback is the less predictable drive to North Creek Parkway. The Hilton minimizes first-morning travel and gives you more protection against traffic, but breakfast is not included and its opening time is still unresolved.
Call the decision based on the audit morning. I can expense breakfast separately if it is available early enough. Tell me exactly what must be confirmed before booking.

Choose the Hilton Garden Inn Seattle/Bothell, subject to one confirmation call. Its shorter and more reliable trip to the supplier is the more important advantage for a 7:45 a.m. arrival. Before booking, ask the property to confirm: weekday breakfast begins no later than 6:30 a.m.; the front desk will hold the room for a Tuesday arrival as late as 10:00 p.m.; self-parking is complimentary under the selected rate; and checkout can provide an itemized folio showing room, tax, breakfast, and incidentals separately. If breakfast starts at 7:00 or later, keep the Hilton but plan an outside breakfast or purchase food Monday evening rather than switching to the longer commute. Book directly on a cancellable rate after those points and the final nightly total are verified. No reservation has been made.
